description: Rise in loan defaults among small business borrowers
mitigation: Tighten credit scoring, review exposure limits, and increase monitoring of high-risk accounts

description: Sharp fall in bond prices due to interest rate hike
mitigation: Hedge with interest rate swaps, diversify the portfolio, and review value-at-risk limits

description: Customers reported fraudulent card transactions overseas
mitigation: Block affected cards, enable real-time fraud alerts, and strengthen transaction monitoring rules

description: Core banking system outage during month-end processing
mitigation: Activate disaster recovery site, communicate with customers, and run a root cause analysis

description: Delay in meeting a regulatory reporting deadline
mitigation: Escalate to compliance head, file an extension request, and automate report generation

description: Liquidity ratio dropped below the internal threshold
mitigation: Arrange short-term funding, reduce illiquid holdings, and review cash flow forecasts daily

description: Phishing attack targeted employees and exposed credentials
mitigation: Reset affected passwords, enforce multi-factor authentication, and run staff awareness training

description: Anti-money laundering alerts not reviewed within the SLA
mitigation: Add analysts to the review team, prioritise high-risk alerts, and tune alert thresholds

description: Third-party payment vendor failed a security audit
mitigation: Demand a remediation plan, limit data sharing, and identify an alternate vendor

description: Currency exchange rate volatility affecting foreign exposure
mitigation: Use forward contracts, set exposure limits per currency, and review hedging strategy

description: Data migration to the new loan system lost customer records
mitigation: Restore from backup, validate record counts, and pause cutover until reconciliation is complete

description: Credit rating of a major corporate borrower was downgraded
mitigation: Re-assess collateral, reduce further exposure, and increase provisioning
